name: Aaila
source: An android that can pass as human if you ignore her robotic movements, the seams on her skin, and the way she speaks. Aaila's liquid brain is the first one of its kind, being able to learn almost indefinitely, like a human one. She has special sensors in her hands and in other places to simulate the sense of touch.
